projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.description: A showcase of my recent work and personal projects demonstrating my skills in web and mobile development.

list.title: Time Tracking System
list.shortDescription: Comprehensive time tracking and productivity management platform for teams.
list.longDescription: Full-stack application developed with Angular and Spring Boot, enabling teams to track working hours, manage projects, and generate detailed reports. The system includes user and role management, an interactive dashboard, and real-time analytics to improve productivity and transparency.

features.dashboard: Interactive analytics dashboard with charts and key performance indicators
features.rbac: Role-Based Access Control for Admin, Manager, and User roles
features.pdf: Dynamic PDF report generation for timesheets and summaries
features.filtering: Advanced server-side filtering, search, and pagination
features.calendar: Integrated calendar view for project and task scheduling

list.title: RAM Assistant
list.shortDescription: Smart mobile application designed to enhance the travel experience with Royal Air Maroc.
list.longDescription: RAM Assistant is an innovative mobile application designed to provide a smooth and personalized travel experience with Royal Air Maroc. Users can access flight information, travel benefits, weather conditions, destination activities, special meal services, assistance requests, visa requirements, and more.

features.flightTracking: Real-time flight tracking and travel updates
features.userServices: Special meal ordering and personalized assistance requests
features.travelInfo: Access to weather, activities, and visa information for destinations
features.notifications: Automatic alerts and reminders before departure
features.offlineMode: Access essential data even without an Internet connection

list.title: Budget Flow
list.shortDescription: Web platform for managing budget requests with a multi-step approval workflow.
list.longDescription: Web application developed from scratch with React.js and TypeScript to manage budget requests in a professional environment. The platform includes a multi-step approval workflow and role-based access control to manage user permissions and workflow actions.

features.workflow: Multi-step approval workflow for budget requests
features.rbac: Role-Based Access Control for user permissions and workflow actions
features.requestManagement: Creation and management of budget requests
features.frontendArchitecture: Modular frontend architecture with reusable components

list.title: Flight Watch
list.shortDescription: Real-time mobile application dedicated to flight tracking and crew operations.
list.longDescription: Real-time mobile application developed with React Native and Expo for crew members in an aviation operational environment. The application manages flights, passengers, crew members, and operational data, with a strong focus on responsiveness and performance.

features.crewManagement: Crew management and operational data handling
features.performance: Re-render optimization and improved application responsiveness

list.title: Skyshop
list.shortDescription: Web and mobile e-commerce platform dedicated to duty-free products.
list.longDescription: E-commerce platform developed with React Native and React.js for duty-free operations. The project includes feature development and maintenance, as well as performance and production stability optimization for the mobile application.

features.ecommerce: E-commerce features for a duty-free platform
features.mobile: Mobile application developed with React Native
